doc.title: Keter Betts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996

title: Joining Ella Fitzgerald and leaving for a Washington club job
summary: Ray Brown suggested him to Ella in 1964; during her summer break he worked a Dixieland club and the Mark Russell TV show and stayed home to buy a house.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: How did the association with Tommy Flanagan and Ella come about?

I stayed with Charlie Byrd until June of ‘64 in Washington, and then I went into the Caverns with Bobby Timmons for three months. And Ray Brown came in and Ray and I have been good friends going back with Herb Ellis and back when I was with Dinah. And whenever they’d come to Washington I used to have them over for dinner, fix dinner for them. So he said, “Ella’s going to need a bass player, would you like to go with her?” And I said, “well okay,” so I went the first time in ‘64. And I stayed a year. And then she usually takes a three month vacation, July and August and start like September or October. At this time this friend of mine in Washington had opened up this club and the day that I got home he called me that night and said, “what are you doing?” I said, “I just got back in town and I’ll be here for about three months.” He said, “my bass player is sick, could you come work at the club?” And I said, “okay, when?” And he said, “starting tomorrow.” And I went in there, and it was like a house group and they were more like Dixieland and he was bringing in various people, Wild Bill Davison and Peanuts Hucko and his wife, and you can go down the list, Pee Wee Russell, Charlie Shavers, Roy Eldridge, you know. So these are the people that would come in here every week. And © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-

then there was a T.V. show that I would do five days a week with Mark Russell, the comedian, the politician comedian, “The Mark and Ginger Show” so I decided not to go back with Ella because by this time we had three children and I wanted to buy a house. So we stayed there and bought the house.
